name: supportauthz
description: AWS Support Authorization AWS SupportAuthZ enables you to control and authorize the actions that AWS support operators can perform on your resources.

subcommands.name: create-support-permit
subcommands.description: Creates a support permit that authorizes an AWS support operator to perform specified actions on specified resources.

subcommands.name: delete-support-permit
subcommands.description: Deletes a support permit, revoking the authorization previously granted to the AWS support operator.

subcommands.name: get-action
subcommands.description: Retrieves the description of a specific support action.

subcommands.name: get-support-permit
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of a support permit by its ARN or name.

subcommands.name: list-actions
subcommands.description: Lists available support actions for a specified AWS service.

subcommands.name: list-support-permit-requests
subcommands.description: Lists permit requests from AWS support operators.

subcommands.name: list-support-permits
subcommands.description: Lists all support permits in the caller's account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with a support permit resource.

subcommands.name: reject-support-permit-request
subcommands.description: Rejects a permit request from an AWS support operator.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or overwrites one or more tags for a support permit resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a support permit resource.
